subject: The one thing 90% of users skip (big mistake)
preview_text: A buried feature in PupShape changed everything for one user. You're probably missing it, too.
body_paragraphs: I got an email last week that stopped me cold. A user named Sarah wrote, 'Anas, I was about to give up. My lab, Bruno, wasn't losing a pound. I felt like a failure.' She was using the meal plans, tracking weight... doing everything 'right.' But she was missing one thing.

Here's the truth: most dog weight loss plans fail because of treats. Not the treats themselves, but the guessing. That 'little extra' peanut butter, the cheese slice 'reward'—it adds hundreds of hidden calories. Sarah was feeding Bruno perfect dinners but accidentally giving him a second lunch in treats. The guilt was eating her alive.

She finally tapped the 'Calorie Calculator for Treats' buried in the 'More' menu. Not the main meal tracker. This little tool. She logged Bruno's favorite biscuit. Then the carrot slices. The chicken bits. The total flashed on screen. Her heart sank. Then she adjusted. One week later, Bruno's chart finally started to dip.

Open PupShape right now. Go to 'More' -> 'Calorie Calculator.' Log just ONE treat you gave today. See the number. That's your first step to unlocking what Sarah found. P.S. The users who master this tool see results 3x faster. It's the secret handshake.
